editInline: Tap the reply to edit it

notReserved: (A time is reserved when you book the viewing.)

step1: Connect Telegram Business or WhatsApp API
step1s: Telegram gives the Mini App and business chats; WhatsApp works through Green API or the official Meta Cloud API (number + token).
step3s: You see every message before it goes out
manualSub: Approve every reply before it is sent
sheetAi: The AI note and STOP line are added automatically.
signIn: Open this page from Telegram. A public browser without sign-in is refused.
signInLive: Open this Mini App from Telegram. Demo sign-in is disabled on the live host.
stale: Previous attempt state unknown, check the chat
digestSim: Counted in the demo. Nothing was sent.
digestDenied: This sign-in cannot request a digest.
connectHint: Checklist is above. Simulator stays optional.
stopHint: Stop automatic replies for this person?
stopDone: Opt-out saved. Automatic replies stay off.
eraseHint: Delete this person's messages from the demo?
eraseKept: The opt-out record stays, so automatic replies stay off.
sentSim: Marked sent in the demo. Nothing left this app.

importBlocked: This site did not return a listing. You can still type it in.
importEmpty: Nothing found on that page. You can still type it in.
importBadUrl: Paste a public http or https link.
makeBrochure: Build a PDF from these fields

draftKept: Your edits stay in the form. The saved property was not changed.
propertyLeadsEmpty: Nobody has asked about this property.
photoLimit: You can add up to 12 photos.
unknownDelivery: Not sure the message went out. Check the chat in Telegram. If it is not there, tap Send again.
forceSendHint: Send the same message again only if it is missing in Telegram.
swipeHint: Swipe right for Processed, left for Confirmed. The list clears itself.
demoModeRow: Demo mode: inbound messages and sending are simulated
actionHot: Reply now: offer two viewing times.
actionWarm: Confirm budget and district, then offer a property.
langWarn: The client writes in {lang}. Replies are available in EN/RU only — check the text or answer manually.
confirmClientSub: Send the confirmation with the time, address and meeting point.
confirmedNote: Client confirmed. Send the confirmation message in one tap.
pilotIntro: Telegram-first pilot for Dubai brokers with an optional WhatsApp channel (official Cloud API or Green API): incoming leads, reply drafts you approve, viewing slots and lists. No raw WhatsApp Web automation, no autopilot.
pilotInc1: Incoming leads from Telegram Business chats
pilotInc2: Reply drafts in EN/RU, grounded in the property card
pilotInc3: Suggested viewing times and manual approval
pilotInc4: CSV export, lists and audit trail
pilotExc1: WhatsApp Web automation — use Green API (third-party bridge) or the official Cloud API; raw personal-number automation is not supported
pilotExc2: Auto-reply and auto-send (every reply goes through your OK)
pilotWarning: One Business bot per Telegram account: connecting this bot disconnects the previous secretary bot.
pilotLang: Replies: EN/RU only. Arabic templates are not available yet — Arabic-speaking leads need a manual reply.
pilotVoice: Voice messages are not transcribed yet; only text is processed.
noteStopSub: Compliance footer on every outgoing message
noteAiSub: Discloses that a draft was prepared with AI
demoWaRow: WhatsApp API — available in live mode
pilotGreen: Green API is a third-party bridge over the WhatsApp Web protocol: the account may face restrictions. For production prefer the official Meta Cloud API.
waSubtitle: Choose a gateway to integrate a WhatsApp number:
waNotConnectedSub: Pick a gateway below and connect your number.
waGreenDesc: Connect by QR code in 2 minutes.
waGreenB2: Works with your current working number
waMetaDesc: Direct connection via Meta for Developers.
waMetaB2: 1000 free conversations per month from Meta
waMetaWarn: Requires a clean number and a verified company
waQrTitle: Scan this QR code with WhatsApp

waScanQr: Scan the QR code to finish connecting.
waCloudSaved: Credentials saved. Paste the webhook URL into Meta.

initMalformed: Could not verify the Telegram session. Open the app from the bot again.
initOpenTelegram: Open this app from the Telegram bot.
initWaitingHint: The session is still loading. Wait a moment or tap Retry.
invalidProperty: Check the title, price, currency and listing link.
propertyNeedPrice: Enter a price greater than zero.
propertyBadLink: The link must start with https:// or http://.
waBadInstance: idInstance must be digits (from the Green API cabinet).
waBadToken: API token is too short or has invalid characters.
waBadCloudPhone: Phone number ID must be digits.
waBadCloudVerify: Verify token may contain only letters, digits, _ and -.
ownerOnlySettings: Channel settings are available to the installation owner only.
ownerOnlyHint: Your leads and properties belong to your account only. To try the interface with demo data, open the demo link.
waInstanceTaken: This Green API instance is already connected to another account. Create a separate instance.
teamInviteSub: Your colleague will see your leads. Share your Telegram ID and the one-time token.
teamAcceptSub: Were you invited? Enter the owner ID and token.
teamInviteCreated: Access created — share the token with your colleague
